fields.description: Duplicity Check code — generated automatically.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: "All Group Companies" applies this setting to every company — no company list needed. Only one setting may claim All Group Companies.
fields.label: Applicable To

fields.description: Pick one or more companies this setting should apply to.
fields.label: Companies

fields.description: Pick the Job Applicant fields that identify the same person (PAN, Aadhaar, UAN, Mobile, Email …). An existing application matching on ANY of these counts as a duplicate. Selecting a field here also makes it MANDATORY on every application this setting applies to — a blank match key would let a duplicate through unnoticed.
fields.label: Duplicity Check Fields

fields.description: Applies to candidates from the external pool (any source other than IJP).
fields.label: Duplicity Check with Candidate Pool

fields.description: A candidate rejected in a job cannot reapply to it for this many days — blocked from any source, so switching source does not bypass it. 0 disables the rule.
fields.label: # of Days Before Reapplication by Candidate if Rejected in a Job
Allow Candidate to Apply for Multiple Positions - Other Sources
Allow Candidate to Apply for Multiple Positions - External Recruiter

fields.description: Refuse a new Job Offer while the same person already holds an active (un-cancelled, not rejected or withdrawn) offer under a DIFFERENT Job Applicant record, matched on the duplicity check fields above. Two offers on the same application are already governed by Recruitment Settings -> "Allow Multiple Active Job Offers per Candidate".
fields.label: Block Job Offers if an Active Job Offer is Present in Any Job

fields.description: Applies when a candidate matches someone who is, or has been, on the payroll. Decided at the Job Offer, not at application — detection is always shown on the Job Applicant's Employee Record tab.
fields.label: Duplicity Check with Employee Pool

fields.description: A former employee cannot be offered a job until this many days have passed since the relieving date on their last employment. 0 disables the rule.
fields.label: # of Days Before Reapplication Post Exit of Last Employment

fields.description: What to do when the candidate matches a currently Active employee and the application did NOT come through IJP. "Exceptional Approval" lets the offer through the Approval Policy Matrix wired to the Job Offer via Flow Config instead of refusing it.
fields.label: Matches an Active Employee & Source is not IJP
fields.options:
Allow Job Offer
Exceptional Approval
Block Job Offer

fields.description: What to do when the candidate matches an inactive employee flagged Do Not Rehire on exit.
fields.label: Matches an Inactive Employee marked Do Not Rehire
fields.options:
Allow Job Offer
Exceptional Approval
Block Job Offer

fields.description: Applies to employees applying internally (source = IJP).
fields.label: For IJP

fields.description: If a member has applied to a job by IJP, the number of days after which a 2nd application to a DIFFERENT job opening is allowed. 0 disables the rule.
fields.label: # of Days Before Reapplication by Member in IJP

fields.description: A member rejected in a job cannot reapply to that job via IJP for this many days. 0 disables the rule.
fields.label: # of Days Before Reapplication by Member if Rejected in a Job
Allow Member to Apply for Multiple Positions via IJP

fields.description: Instead of refusing a candidate who matches any rule above, let the hiring go ahead under closer control: the candidate runs on a separate hiring workflow, and their Job Offer goes through an exceptional approval.
fields.label: Allow Hiring on Duplicity Match

fields.description: Every rule in this setting that would block — at application or at Job Offer — lets the candidate through instead, and so does every outcome set to Exceptional Approval. The candidate is flagged on the Job Applicant with the reasons. Outcomes set to Allow Job Offer are unaffected. Override permission holders are never flagged.
fields.label: Allow Hiring Even Though It Matches Duplicity Check Settings

fields.description: The hiring stages a flagged candidate goes through, in place of the Job Opening's own. Takes effect only while Recruitment Settings -> Enable Hiring Workflow is on.
fields.label: Hiring Workflow

fields.description: The Flow Config that approves a flagged candidate's Job Offer. Set it up with Module Transaction = Job Offer, Trigger Type = Document Event, Doc Event Type = on_update, Doc Event Field = custom_duplicity_approval_trigger, and Value = the Flow Config's own name (for a versioned flow, the name of its first version). Several settings may share one flow.
fields.label: Exceptional Approval Workflow

fields.description: Master switch. With this off, nobody can override — the roles below are ignored.
fields.label: Allow Permission Holders to Override Duplicity Check Settings for All Sources

fields.description: Holders of any role listed here bypass every rule in this setting, for all sources. Administrator and System Manager always may.
fields.label: Override Roles
